races.verdict: A winner in points since last seen under Rules in Ireland, DEPALMA is clearly a fascinating runner for the Dan Skelton yard (bought for £20,000 in May) and could well be worth chancing to immediately repay some of the investment on just his second start over fences. DEPALMA (IRE) HARRYS HOPE (IRE) RIDIN SOLO (IRE)

races.display_title: Aesterius At Bearstone Stud Handicap
races.verdict: PARISIAC wasn't seen to anything like best effect at Hamilton last time and is fancied to capitalise on a lenient-looking mark now. Lipsink rates a big threat though on the back of a narrow Sandown reverse, while Accrual , Changeofmind and Creative Queen also need factoring into this open sprint. PARISIAC (IRE) LIPSINK (IRE) ACCRUAL

races.display_title: Arete Foundation Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict: This is wide open but it could pay to side with CLEMENTINES STAR who had looked on the up until not seen to best effect from a poor draw when third on her handicap bow at Chepstow. Recent Ffos Las scorer Cypriot Diaspora rates a big threat under a penalty though, while Dream Illusion , Imelda and Gelato can all play a prominent role too. CLEMENTINES STAR CYPRIOT DIASPORA DREAM ILLUSION

races.display_title: Betfair Supports Racing Welfare Handicap
races.verdict: Lots with chances. LESRICO returned from a break with an encouraging seventh to Naturalia at Ayr last month so could prove the answer here given he has a good record on soft ground. Donald Whillans' mare is feared most despite taking a 3 lb rise, although course winner Blue Wonder is weighted to go well if shrugging aside a lesser effort at Leicester. LESRICO NATURALIA BLUE WONDER (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: Naturalia (7/2), Tortured Soul (5/1), Blue Wonder (6/1), Yokohama (7/1), Star Time (7/1), Ziggy's Avenger (8/1), Marianita (10/1), Green Falcon (14/1), Lightning Tiger (14/1), Hamadhan (20/1), Made All (20/1), Lesrico (25/1), Flash Bardot (25/1)

races.display_title: Midland Veterinary Beginners Chase
races.verdict: LOS BLANCO jumped soundly on chasing debut at Wexford and, with improvement anticipated from a yard second to none with chasers, he is selected to come out on top. Fou de Toi found chasing more to his liking than hurdling when second at Ballinrobe and looks the chief threat, while chase debutant Manoir de Mirande is bred to excel in this sphere if able to keep his quirks in check. races.display_title: Kilsaran Handicap Chase
races.verdict: PINOT GRIS posted a career best over hurdles at Galway last month and is expected to go close now returned to fences from a 6 lb lower mark. Hashtag Pretender showed a good attitude when opening his chase account at Roscommon last month despite several mistakes and is likely to prove the main danger if more assured in the jumping department and seeing out the trip. Charlie Luciano won at this course earlier in the summer and is also respected. PINOT GRIS (IRE) HASHTAG PRETENDER (FR) CHARLIE LUCIANO (IRE)

Gangster Granny can't be ruled out given her recent form over hurdles, with Boxing Great and Trubshaw leading the remaining dangers. RAGMANS CORNER (IRE) GANGSTER GRANNY (IRE) BOXING GREAT (IRE)
